chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl, from one of our companions who said:
We complained to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about our clothes being lost with the fullers (cleaners). He said: 'Write upon them,
ai.seo_question: What did the Imam advise to prevent clothes from being lost by the cleaners?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructed the companions to inscribe 'Barakah for us' (blessing from the Ahl al-Bayt) on their garments before sending them to the tailors, a practice rooted in the Shia belief that the spiritual presence of the Imams confers divine protection. Upon implementing this, the garments were preserved from loss, illustrating the tangible efficacy of invoking the Imams' blessings in daily affairs.
